 Will 'Nobody Wants This' Return for Season 4?
 Rebecca Perlmutter Wed, October 21, 2026 at 4:47 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Adam Brody as Noah, Kristen Bell as Joanne in episode 301 of Nobody Wants This - Netflix Ahead of Nobody Wants This Season 3, fans are already eager for a fourth season of the spicy podcast host x hot rabbi rom-com.
 Heading into Season 3 , showrunner Bruce Eric Kaplan explained, "After the ups and downs of Noah and Joanne in Season 2, it was really important to us to be like, 'Let's let them have their moment now of settling in and having fun.' We didn't have to do any more 'will they, won't they?' We know they are going to, and it was sort of, ' How are they going to?'" What question would a potential Season 4 answer?
 Scroll to find out everything we know so far about Nobody Wants This Season 4, including when the season would premiere, who's returning to the series, and more updates.
 Has Nobody Wants This been renewed for Season 4?
 Right now, Nobody Wants This has yet to be renewed for Season 4. We'll have to wait until the Season 3 finale to find out if the door is left open with lingering questions that need to be answered with another season. We'd expect to hear whether the series has been renewed or will end at Season 3 within the coming weeks.
 Justine Lupe as Morgan, Timothy Simons as Sasha in episode 306 of Nobody Wants This Netflix
 Who would return for Season 4 of Nobody Wants This Season 4?
 If Nobody Wants This returns for another season, we'd expect to see Adam Brody and Kristen Bell return as Noah and Joanne, as well as Justine Lupe as Morgan, Timothy Simons as Sasha, and Jackie Tohn as Esther. Noah and Joanne's parents, played by Tovah Feldshuh , Paul Ben-Victor , Stephanie Faracy , and Michael Hitchcock , and Joanne and Morgan's friend Ashley, played by Sherry Cola , would likely return as well.
 Kristen Bell as Joanne, Jackie Tohn as Esther in episode 305 of Nobody Wants This Netflix

 When will Nobody Wants This Season 4 premiere?
 There's no set premiere date for Nobody Wants This just yet! Seasons 1-3 have dropped on Netflix every year since 2024 in September and October, so fans can expect to see a fall 2027 release if the series is renewed. Here's hoping!
